column6: Peer-reviewed JARG paper on SpermQT (Path Fertility / Inherent Biosciences) published 26 Jan 2026; company newsroom dated the same day.
USAF/AFWERX SBIR Phase II FA8649-25-P-0506 to InnoSys Inc ($1.75M) with award start 24 Sep 2025 and end 30 Dec 2026 for SSVD rad-hard electronics manufacturing.
Instructure dated July 2026 product-update blog (page dated 7 Aug 2026) announcing Canvas Core/Plus/Next tiers and IgniteAI Agent shipping in North America.
Intactis Bio PR Newswire 21 Jul 2026 launching Biostack Alpha, a public demo of its living-neuron Biohybrid Processing Unit; work continues under the same company.
Intan RHX data-acquisition software v3.5.1 dated 21 May 2026 on the company downloads page; chip sales continue, systems now distributed by White Mountain Systems.
Company 1 May 2025 announcement of sole-source thermal-management award on L3Harris/US Navy NGJ-LB; site says work continues under Unison, a GE Aerospace company (absorbed is not ended).
Utah Business 27 Oct 2025 names Interval as a Philo Sandbox Fund portfolio company; company jobs board still lists a live Lehi full-cycle sales opening (undated).
Ionic MT company press dated 11 Jul 2025 closing oversubscribed $29M Series B to scale Ionisil/IonAl production at its Provo plant.
Nature Biomedical Engineering (May 2025) names Iris Biomedical as a Ripple spin-out still working on the Athena implantable sensing/stim platform; company site has no dated posts, no jobs found.
JobNimbus 5 Aug 2026 announcement of NimbusLabs early-access feature program, with Analytics AI already in customer use (Olympus Roofing quoted).
TechBuzz 29 Jul 2026 on-scene report of Jump Aero displaying the JA1 Pulse mockup at South Valley Regional Airport and pitching UDOT/rural EMS; aircraft still in development.
Co-founder Charles Merriam posted 16 Jul 2026 that the team shut KEVA after finding no market pull for a Wi-Fi-free smart lock; site still markets the product.

L3Harris Q2 2026 earnings release 29 Jul 2026; Communications & Spectrum Dominance revenue up, the segment that includes the Salt Lake Falcon/comms work; official SLC careers board still lists ~170 openings.
Leland company post 25 Mar 2026 launching the AI Builder Program (cohorts from April 2026); TechBuzz independently covered the Lehi launch 7 Apr 2026.
Company 18 Jun 2026 post on winning Gold in Best of Southern Utah 2026 Managed IT/Office Technology; also named Ricoh Pro Dealer 9 Feb 2026.
LVT 25 Feb 2026 press announcing Insight LPR partnership for mobile-unit license-plate recognition, generally available May 2026.
Lucid Software PR Newswire 13 Apr 2026 launching a Lucid app for ChatGPT powered by its MCP server; product work continues at the South Jordan company.
Medical Product Outsourcing 7 Jul 2026 reports MasterControl released Event Summarizer, an AI quality-event tool on its ISO 42001 ADAPT platform.
Merit Medical Systems 10-Q for quarter ended 31 Mar 2026, filed 30 Apr 2026, reporting $381.9M Q1 revenue; South Jordan HQ/manufacturing continues.
Moises (Music AI) App Store listing shows version 2.140.0 shipped ~8 hours before check on 13 Aug 2026; seller Moises Systems Inc, ongoing app updates.
